/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if test -f /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/97c511c69497/workspace/round-brief.md; then sed -n '1,240p' /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/97c511c69497/workspace/round-brief.md; fi
sed -n '1,240p' /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/97c511c69497/workspace/ticket.md
sed -n '1,240p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
printf '%s\\n' '--- test commands ---'
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml

rg -n -C 2 'non-Error|recorded flaw|rejection|onError' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/.*#|spec:' src/orchestration src | head -40

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add src/orchestration/onErrorCause.test.ts src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts src/orchestration/rejectingProvider.test-helper.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md

git merge origin/main
